unknown_identity_policy: index 0 is explicit unknown; historical source unknown judge identities are not learned as ordinary identities; identities first appearing on or after the vocab cutoff (the date-forward validation boundary) also map to unknown so no embedding row is evaluation-only and untrained
clean_control_embedding_policy: compact dataset-matched maps only: unknown=0 and embedding input dimension=max(index)+1; final2's unrelated global-map capacity is not retained
dev2_change_reason: dev1 assigned trained embedding IDs to identities that appear only in the validation/test window (e.g. calgary-round-up-band, high-school-affiliated-to-bit); their untrained embeddings emitted random residuals and caused the clean-control zero-history total MAE of 5.56. dev2 restricts vocabulary to pre-cutoff rows.
